input_workaround: Open the local Screen Sharing View menu, read its AX state, cancel that menu, and perform the remote click within the same CUA call (100–200 ms mouse-down). Keeping these actions together restores reliable foreground delivery. Type into fields, inspect the entered value, then commit by clicking a different control. No persistent system setting or audio configuration change.
